description: Upwork's official MCP server, letting this AI Digital Employee work with Upwork on the connected user's behalf: pull the account dashboard, search and shortlist freelancers, post and manage jobs, invite freelancers and review proposals, respond to invitations/offers and prepare offers, manage contracts and milestones, read financials and time reports, message freelancers or clients, manage talent lists, and handle file attachments -- strictly based on the permissions of the connected Upwork account. Every write action is a draft the user confirms separately; binding actions (offers, milestone funding) complete on upwork.com.
